name: 02467 · Chestnut Hill, MA
findings: ZIP 02467 (Chestnut Hill) has 139 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02467 (Chestnut Hill) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02467 (Chestnut Hill) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 22% of the typical level).
